sources_considered.why: Primary employer research reports work transfers and employee reassignment. This is substantial counterevidence, although the reported example does not establish the extent of continuing supervision.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic describes a product-content team transferring work to agents and moving into prompting and evaluations in spring 2026. This challenges the broad denial of replacement, but does not establish how independently the agents perform the complete former roles.

The research measures success on bounded tasks and discusses substantial measurement uncertainty. Those results do not directly measure job replacement or establish a permanent inability to perform precise work.

unresolved_gaps: The strongest retrieved deployment report does not quantify supervision, corrections, or coverage of the complete responsibilities transferred.
No retrieved record conclusively connects sustained autonomous performance of a complete job with identifiable staffing replacement.
No deadline makes continued absence of a qualifying deployment insufficient to support the forecast.
